book.title: Book in a minute
book.text: Pick your services, a time that suits you and your master. The studio sees it right away.

visits.title: Your visits, sorted
visits.text: Reminders before each visit, one tap to add it to your calendar, and change or cancel it yourself.

loyalty.title: Every visit counts
loyalty.text: Each visit is a stamp on your loyalty card, and some visits come with a discount.

home.title: Always one tap away
home.text: Add the app to your home screen: it opens full screen and your bookings are always at hand.

ready.title: You're all set
ready.text: Services, bookings, your loyalty card and the studio's contacts, all in one place.
